objective: Relay Rounds v0.3: a shared ground-level race circuit split into one sector per leg with per-sector obstacles, anime/stylish-action movement (double jump, air dash, boost and launch pads), a cosmetic style meter, and custom part-built models (torii gates, demon finish gate, lanterns, sakura, spires, grandstand) with sunset lighting.
inputs: SHANNON request 2026-10-25: polish, custom models, less straight running, anime runners and Devil May Cry as inspiration
acceptance_criteria: One closed ground-level circuit shared by all teams; racers pass through each other
Lap split into one sector per leg with a handoff box per team at each sector line
Six obstacle sets, one per sector on its longest straight, re-rolled each round
Touching lava, a live laser or a sweeper sends the runner back to their sector start (server-checked)
Double jump and air dash once per airtime; the client sends nothing to the server
Style meter D to SSS with diminishing repeats (StyleRules unit tests)
CI green with both places built
